portal_hypertension.title: Outcomes of Peroral Endoscopic Myotomy in Patients With Cirrhosis: A Multicenter Focused Communication.
portal_hypertension.authors: Butt MA, Mirminachi B, Cifuentes L
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：由于担心门脉高压和出血风险，肝硬化和食管动力障碍的患者经常被排除在经口内镜肌切开术 (POEM) 之外。 临床提示：因此，有关该人群 POEM 的数据有限。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Patients with cirrhosis and esophageal motility disorders are frequently excluded from peroral endoscopic myotomy (POEM) because of concerns related to portal hypertension and bleeding risk. As a result, data on POEM in this population are limited. We describe a multicenter experience evaluating the feasibility and short-term outcomes of POEM in patients with cirrhosis. We retrospectively reviewed cirrhotic patients who underwent POEM at six U.S. tertiary centers between 2020 and 2024. Technical success was defined as completion of myotomy without conversion or major intraprocedural bleeding. Clinical success was defined as a 6-month Eckardt score ≤3.
